user_query: I was charged a $35 overdraft fee in California. Is this legal?
analysis_notes: Banks in California may charge overdraft fees but must disclose them. The $35 fee aligns with disclosed rates per overdraft_faq.txt#0. Complaint COMP-001 shows a similar pattern.

retrieved_docs.raw_text: Banks may charge overdraft fees when a transaction exceeds the available balance.
